## Purpose
The route tree generated by TanStack Router from `src/routes/` files. It is never edited by hand.

## Responsibilities
It imports every route module and assembles the tree, with its type registrations.

Paths include:
- `/` and `/welcome`;
- `/login`, `/forgot-password`, `/invite/$token`, `/reset-password/$token`, `/account`;
- the admin area: `/admin`, `/admin/login`, `/admin/account`, `/admin/admins`, `/admin/audit` (and `$eventId`), `/admin/health`, `/admin/logs` (and `$workspaceId/$traceId`), `/admin/roles` (and `$id`), `/admin/users` (and `$id`), `/admin/workspaces` (and `$id`);
- `/agents` and `$id`, `/connectors` and `$id`, `/tools` and `$id`, `/mcp` and `$serverName`;
- `/libraries`, `/knowledge`, `/ontology` (and `/ontology/libraries/$libraryId`);
- `/processes` and `$industryId`, `/rules` and `$id`;
- `/remote-servers` (`new`, `$id`);
- `/logs` (`$traceId`, `execution/$executionId`);
- `/health`, `/playground`, `/reviews`, `/settings`;
- the workflows: `/workflows`, `archived`, `activities` (and `$id`), `new` (`ai` and `visual`), and `$workflowName` (with `edit`, `execute` and `refine`).

## Key elements
`routeTree`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Generated by:** `@tanstack/router-plugin`.
- **Read by:** `router.tsx`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **It is regenerated on dev and build;** excluded from Prettier, and marked `@ts-nocheck`.
- **File names map to paths:** `.` becomes `/`, `$x` is a parameter, and `index` is the index route.

## How to rebuild this file
Do not write it. It is produced by running `vite dev` or `vite build` once the routes exist.

## Tests
None.
